hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; g="$d/.planning/graphs/graph.json"; if [ -f "$g" ]; then built=$(grep -o '"built_at_commit": *"[a-f0-9]*"' "$g" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | grep -o '[a-f0-9]*"$' | tr -d '"'); cur=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$built" ] && [ -n "$cur" ]; then case "$cur" in "$built"*) : ;; *) printf '{"systemMessage":"graphify: Wissensgraph ist STALE (gebaut @%.7s) - Rebuild anstossen."}' "$built";; esac; fi; fi; true
